meta.note: No Figma exists for auth: the HTML prototypes are the design. Web sign-in = light only. Mobile authenticator = light on :root + dark pairs under [data-theme="dark"]: color.app-light and color.app-dark share the same keys; non-colour dark pairs are keyed "<name>--dark". Comments carry "src: file Lline".
